item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera keeps a potted money plant in her kitchen garden. She fixes a wide-mouthed bottle containing potassium hydroxide pellets over one half of a destarched leaf, while the other half stays outside in the open air. After keeping the plant in sunlight for 6 hours, she tests the leaf with iodine solution. Only the half outside the bottle turns blue-black. What does this experiment show?

options.A: Potassium hydroxide helps the leaf to prepare starch
options.B: Sunlight alone is enough for the leaf to prepare starch
options.C: Carbon dioxide from the air is essential for the plant to prepare starch
options.D: The half-leaf inside the bottle produced more starch than the half outside
